envelope.description: Host: write-then-post with row indexes, and answer load-older

body.title: Host: write-then-post with row indexes, and answer load-older
body.summary: In chat-panel.ts make appendEvent return the index of the row it wrote; in the run sink and the followed-turn sink call appendEvent first and post second with `rowIndex` (in the followed sink the write stays before and outside the `!disposed && session === s` guard); in recordPermissionOutcome and recordSelectionOutcome push first and post with `rowIndex` (none when there is no session); add `rowIndex` to runTurn's user-row. Add the `load-older` handler: validate sessionId and before, ignore a request for a session that is not active, and post one transcript-page cut by pageBefore. session-restored still carries the whole transcript, now with firstIndex 0 and total; any existing deep-equality assertion on that payload is updated here. AMENDED: the earlier check that a turn followed for a session that is not shown 'still writes its rows' described a state that cannot occur, because a chat switch or a closed panel aborts the follow at once; it is replaced by what the code does.
acceptanceChecks: Every persisted live row (assistant, marker, tool-result, user, permission outcome, selection outcome) is posted with the absolute index of a row the transcript already holds; status and approval-request carry none
The rows written to the transcript are unchanged

A followed turn's row is written before it is posted with its index; after a chat switch the follow stops, posting and writing nothing more (the rest is read again on the next resume, as before this change); in the followed-turn sink the write is before and outside the shown-session guard
load-older for the active session answers one transcript-page ending just before `before`; repeated requests walk back to 0
load-older for another session id, or with a malformed before or sessionId, posts nothing
session-restored carries firstIndex 0 and total, and the existing session-restored assertions pass

tests.name: live rows carry rowIndex from all five writers: assistant, marker and tool-result events, the user-row, a permission outcome and a selection outcome are each posted with the absolute index of the row already written; status and approval-request carry none
write-then-post order: when each live row is posted, the transcript already holds it at that index
a followed turn writes each row before posting it; after a chat switch the follow stops, posting and writing nothing more; the write is outside the shown-session guard
load-older for the active session answers one transcript-page whose rows end just before `before`; repeated requests walk back to index 0
load-older for another session id, or with a malformed before or sessionId, posts nothing
session-restored carries firstIndex 0 and total while the whole transcript is still sent
